channel.title: Soheil Mohajer — Blog
channel.description: Research notes and write-ups on Android, AI agents, automation and game logic.

item.title: Building a Resilient Adhan Scheduler on Android
item.description: AlarmManager lessons from shipping Gah-e Saba: exact alarms, doze mode, OEM battery killers, boot receivers — and how to make scheduling code you cannot fully control testable.

item.title: RTL Survival Guide: Fixing Bidirectional Text in AI Chat UIs
item.description: Why mixing Persian and English breaks in ChatGPT-style UIs, how first-strong detection fails on streamed responses, and the MutationObserver approach shipped in ParsiChat Fixer.

item.title: n8n vs Code-First Agents: Where Low-Code Actually Wins
item.description: After shipping both, an honest comparison of iteration speed, debugging, versioning and cost — and the hybrid architecture I now default to.
